text: A small number of customers account for a large share of our revenue, and the loss of any one of them would materially harm our results of operations.
Our products depend on components sourced from a single overseas supplier, and any disruption there would delay shipments to our customers.
We compete with larger, better-capitalized firms in every market we serve, and some competitors offer similar products at lower prices.
Our gross margin declined in fiscal 2025 due to higher input costs for raw materials and freight, and we expect these costs to stay elevated through the next fiscal year.
We are subject to changing regulations in the jurisdictions where we operate, and new environmental rules could increase our compliance costs.
Our headquarters and primary distribution center are located in a single facility, so a natural disaster there could disrupt our operations.
We rely on a small management team, and the loss of any key executive could disrupt our strategy and operations.
Fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates could adversely affect our reported revenue and operating results.
Total revenue for fiscal 2025 was 18,240 thousand dollars, compared with 15,900 thousand dollars in fiscal 2024.
We may need additional capital in the future, and financing may not be available on acceptable terms.
Our information systems could be subject to cyberattacks, which could disrupt operations or expose customer data.
We hold patents and trademarks that are important to our business, and we cannot be certain that we can enforce them effectively.
Increases in the cost of raw materials and higher freight rates were the primary drivers of the decline in our gross margin during fiscal 2025.
We have not paid dividends on our common stock and do not intend to do so in the foreseeable future.
Our stock price has been volatile and may continue to fluctuate significantly regardless of our operating performance.
We lease our manufacturing facilities under agreements that expire at various dates through 2030.
We are, from time to time, subject to legal proceedings arising in the ordinary course of business.
Our effective tax rate may fluctuate due to changes in the mix of earnings among jurisdictions.
We depend on third-party logistics providers, and disruptions to their networks could delay delivery of our products.
Climate change may result in more frequent extreme weather events that could disrupt our supply chain.
